dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual narrowing from the widest mid-body section toward the posterior peduncle, creating a standard teardrop-shaped 2D profile.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: A subtle asymmetrical bulge is visible along the right lateral margin (viewer's perspective) near the posterior end.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Mature white with low-intensity grey shading along the lateral boundaries and neck fold.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: A distinct, dark vertical linear mark is visible on the lower dorsal midline, accompanied by several faint longitudinal parallel lines.
high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.dorsal_surface_indentations: A shallow longitudinal crease or depression is visible along the central dorsal axis.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Multiple faint, linear marks resembling superficial rake marks are visible across the mid-dorsal and posterior regions.
other_distinctive_markers: The blowhole is visible as a high-contrast, dark circular aperture located on the anterior dorsal plane.
